summary: A worktree is a strong default for parallel repository mutation because it prevents agents from overwriting one checkout, but it is only the filesystem layer of isolation.

points.text: Give every task a unique branch, worktree path and ownership record, and integrate through reviewed commits rather than copying untracked files between trees.
Allocate distinct ports, databases, caches, containers and test namespaces where concurrent runtimes could interfere.
Merge or rebase frequently enough to surface overlap while context is still warm; isolation that delays all feedback until the end increases integration cost.
